label: methyl-based methanogenesis
definition: A methanogenesis in which methylated compounds donate methyl groups that are transferred to coenzyme M and reduced to methane.
observations: Methyl-substrate methanogenesis branch covering methyl dismutation and hydrogen-dependent methyl-reducing pathways; absent from live METPO except for METPO:1000866 obsolete Methylotrophic methanogenesis and distinct from broader methylotrophy.
